reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the cited paragraphs are left untouched.

The cited text supports compliance: §5(a) imposes only ongoing monthly minimum service charges for services actually delivered, and §§13-14 require only notice with service continuing to month-end — no liquidated damages, penalty, early-termination fee, or minimum-remaining-value payment by Client.

The monthly minimum ($__ per month) is correctly characterized as pricing for services received rather than a Customer-payable liquidated amount, and is noted in the rationale rather than over-flagged as a deviation.
Rule is directional and only triggers when Customer pays; nothing in the cited provisions creates such an obligation, so the preferred position is met.
